regeneration.summary: Active hero is a v2 regeneration. The v1 hero (rejected/img_v1-selfreview-rejected.jpg) was rejected in Cora's creator self-review: Only two fritters were on the plate; the brief and recipe serve three per plate.
regeneration.prompt_change: v2 prompt is Cora's rewrite of the v1 prompt, recorded verbatim in image-prompt.md 'Active prompt (v2)' (source notes/prompts-v2-selfreview.txt); the v1 prompt is kept under 'Superseded prompt (v1)', and image-plating-brief.md was rebuilt to match v2.
changes: Hero states exactly three (count them: three) round fritters overlapping in a row.
Must show adds one fritter broken open to show the set, green-flecked interior.
Do not include adds two or four fritters.
The v2 prompt has no separate Sauce or Color line; the sauce and color sections of image-plating-brief.md restate what the v2 hero and must-show lines already say.
The v2 prompt shortens the lighting line and drops the Chipotle Lime Black Bean Bowl quality-reference sentence; it keeps the no text, logos, watermarks, or hands line.
